name: Lawrence County, TN
findings: Lawrence County has 95 nonprofit organizations. 29 of them (31%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 23 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (30% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Lawrence County has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Lawrence County list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 62% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 23 organizations here; 48% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find public events now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Social and fraternal organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 6 social and fraternal organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 6 organizations here; 48% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do social and fraternal organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: Few religious organizations list public events
observations.text: 2 religious organizations here list public events. In similar places of this size, about 6 would.

confidence.text: Based on 6 organizations here; 48% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for public events through religious groups? Where else does that happen?
